title: splitandaggregate router
description: Splits the body, sends every part along the outbound link with rule split, aggregates what comes out and sends the message with the aggregate on along the other link.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the expression: xpath (//a), jsonpath ($.a[*]), tokenize (the text to split at), xtokenize (an XML element path or name) or simple (an expression that gives a list, such as ${body.split(',')})

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Selects the parts; if empty, the split link's expression

aggregateType.title: Aggregate type
aggregateType.description: XML: the parts' root elements in <Aggregated>; JSON: an array of the parts

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect yet

parallelProcessing.title: Parallel processing
parallelProcessing.description: Process split parts concurrently with structured joining; aggregated results preserve input order

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent branches when parallelProcessing is true; 0 uses the engine default

branchTimeout.title: Branch timeout
branchTimeout.description: Per-branch timeout in milliseconds when parallelProcessing is true; 0 means no timeout

failFast.title: Fail fast
failFast.description: Cancel sibling branches on the first failure when parallelProcessing is true

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect yet
